notes.title: The Anniv3rsary Update is Live! 🎉
notes.content:
Dear Saviors! 👨‍🚀

Big news! The 3-year anniversary update has launched today with achievements, a comprehensive visual refreshment, various upgrades and fixes on board! 🚀

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41200273/1cc2b8eab4ee0185c667a9eb132b39586d0717a5.jpg

There are six achievements to get. Three to track story progress and three for the challenge. See achievement list here. Progress achievements will be granted to former saviors on first startup. 🏆

Visuals upgrade includes:
🎨 material and texture updates
⛰️ new terrain materials
✨ better effects
🖌️ anti-aliasing
🔥 opimized lights and models

Highest (now called ultra) quality level may be slightly more demanding to keep up with the needs of better graphics, however, low settings will perform better than before. Two new graphics quality levels are introduced for balance. 🖼️

[previewyoutube=Dtf4r6w0WTI;full][/previewyoutube]
I also implemented several changes and fixes to UI, inputs, gameplay and saves.
See detailed patch notes for v1.3.0 here.

There's more! 🎉

I always wanted to offer something extra to appreciate your financial support, so I created a digital artbook with 60+ exclusive images and added it to the Donation DLCs, along with the three original music tracks from the game. New and former donors can access them from the game's folder upon updating. Thank you for your support! 🙏

Safe journeys,
K
